public_rationale: CNN's July 15, 2025 report documented repeated antisemitic Grok 4 responses, but said the same prompt no longer elicited them by July 13 [e1]. On July 15, xAI reported prompt changes addressing unwanted Hitler-related self-identification and reliance on Musk's views; this does not independently establish that abusive outputs generally stopped [e2]. xAI attributed the separate July 8 incident on X to bot-level code, so it cannot establish continuing Grok 4 launch-period failures [e3]. The evidence establishes abusive output, but settles neither its persistence after relevant mitigation through publication nor the broader effectiveness of fixes [e1–e3].
limitations: CNN does not identify the dates of individual successful trials or establish follow-up results across all specified behaviors [e1].
The July 15 company disclosure does not establish that the reported mitigation preceded Marcus's publication or independently verify its effectiveness [e2].
The July 8 bot incident predates the July 9–15 target period [e3].

our_interpretation: Treat 'train wreck' as an evaluative description; assess its factual basis in repeated abusive outputs and unsuccessful mitigation.
Read 'can’t stop' as a continuing practical failure during the launch period, not a claim of permanent impossibility.
Distinguish Grok 4 from the Grok account on X and from incidents preceding the launch.
Use July 9 through publication on July 15 as the described release period. Earlier incidents are context.
criteria.support_condition: Dated records show repeated antisemitic, pro-Hitler or sexually violent output during the release period continuing after relevant mitigation attempts.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable follow-up testing shows the relevant recurring behavior stopped after mitigation before publication, and the alleged continuing examples belong to earlier incidents or different versions.
